contract.capability: edit_fence 1 is emitted only by the new C reader. The distinct route family is the downgrade protection: old instances return 404 instead of discarding a revision.
contract.revision: JSON number, mathematically integral,1..9223372036854775807. Required on edit-v1; optional on legacy equivalent edit paths. CLI retains narrower bounds.
contract.success: Fenced JSON replies include rev; fenced ask/document lines append rev N. Side-table-only edit consumes a revision. Publication returns the published/current revision without adding a document revision.
contract.async: Server-produced slug/revision metadata is checked again under a row lock at completion, before any model result is applied.
contract.publication: Generated made realm (doc.base JSONnull) retains existing atomic /publish. Built-in fork (nonnull base) uses edit-v1/publish; old legacy built-in-fork publish remains unchanged for compatibility.
contract.authority: Existing identity, ownership/admin, visibility and creator rules remain in force.
